_comment: Broker seed data. AUM figures are approximate public figures for context/normalization only; each carries an as_of date and is refreshed manually. finra_crd = CRD number of the retail broker-dealer entity.

brokers.name: Fidelity
brokers.regulatory_notes: SEC-registered broker-dealer; FINRA and SIPC member. AUM figure is total assets under administration (company-reported, approximate).

brokers.name: Charles Schwab
brokers.regulatory_notes: SEC-registered broker-dealer; FINRA and SIPC member. AUM figure is total client assets (company-reported, approximate). Completed TD Ameritrade integration in 2024.

brokers.name: Vanguard
brokers.regulatory_notes: SEC-registered broker-dealer; FINRA and SIPC member. AUM figure is global assets under management (company-reported, approximate).

brokers.name: Robinhood
brokers.regulatory_notes: SEC-registered broker-dealer; FINRA and SIPC member. AUM figure is assets under custody (company-reported, approximate). Notable regulatory history includes a 2021 FINRA settlement (public record).

brokers.name: Interactive Brokers
brokers.regulatory_notes: SEC-registered broker-dealer; FINRA and SIPC member. AUM figure is client equity (company-reported, approximate).

brokers.name: E*TRADE
brokers.legal_name: E*TRADE from Morgan Stanley (Morgan Stanley Smith Barney LLC)
brokers.regulatory_notes: Operated by Morgan Stanley since 2020 acquisition; FINRA and SIPC member. Standalone E*TRADE client-asset figures are no longer disclosed separately by Morgan Stanley (marked unavailable rather than estimated).

brokers.name: Merrill Edge
brokers.legal_name: Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Inc. (Bank of America)
brokers.regulatory_notes: Self-directed platform of Bank of America's Merrill unit; FINRA and SIPC member. AUM figure is approximate Merrill Edge self-directed client balances (company-reported, approximate).

brokers.name: SoFi Invest
brokers.regulatory_notes: Brokerage arm of SoFi Technologies (invest product launched 2019; SoFi founded 2011); FINRA and SIPC member. SoFi does not disclose Invest client assets separately (marked unavailable rather than estimated). CRD available via FINRA BrokerCheck.

brokers.name: Webull
brokers.regulatory_notes: FINRA and SIPC member. Client-asset totals not reliably disclosed (marked unavailable rather than estimated). Parent-company ownership structure has drawn public/congressional scrutiny (public record). CRD available via FINRA BrokerCheck.

brokers.name: Ally Invest
brokers.regulatory_notes: Brokerage arm of Ally Financial (former TradeKing, acquired 2016); FINRA and SIPC member. Ally does not disclose Invest client assets separately (marked unavailable rather than estimated). CRD available via FINRA BrokerCheck.

brokers.name: J.P. Morgan Self-Directed
brokers.regulatory_notes: Self-directed platform inside the Chase app/site (launched 2018 as 'You Invest'); FINRA and SIPC member. JPMorgan does not disclose self-directed client assets separately (marked unavailable rather than estimated).
